description: This file contains TypeScript source code defining dispatcher classes for Electron within Playwright's server architecture, including ElectronDispatcher and ElectronApplicationDispatcher, responsible for managing Electron applications and related events.

classes.name: ElectronDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class managing the Electron runtime, providing a launch method to start Electron applications with optional launch restrictions.

classes.name: ElectronApplicationDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class managing an Electron application instance, handling events like close and console, and providing methods to interact with Electron application windows and evaluate expressions.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a new Electron application with specified parameters, respecting the denyLaunch flag.

methods.name: browserWindow
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a specific browser window within the Electron application.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression within the context of the Electron application and returns the result.

methods.name: evaluateExpressionHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: updateSubscription
methods.description: Enables or disables event subscriptions for the Electron application.

ctags.name: ElectronDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class ElectronDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Electron, channels.ElectronChannel, RootDispa/
